newsitem.title: CHINA: BOC gives China aviation industry $15 bln loans.
newsitem.headline: BOC gives China aviation industry $15 bln loans.

text.p: The state-owned commercial Bank of China has so far extended a total of $15 billion in foreign exchange loans and guarantees to China's Civil Aviation Administration and its subsidiary companies, the People's Daily said on Thursday.
The foreign exchange loans and guarantees provided by the bank helped to boost the number of China's civilian aircraft to more than 400 in 1995 from more than 100 in 1979, the newspaper said.
The bank was also providing loans to help the construction of airports and the development of local airlines, it said.
The bank would continue to give priority to loans designated for the transport industry and key state enterprises, the newspaper said. It did not give further details.
